Lexicon Latīnitātis Cotīdiānae
Aa

Macrons

Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Household, washing & chores

toilet noun

also latrine, public toilet, flush the toilet, flush, relieve oneself, go to the toilet, I must go to the toilet

classical

Traupman 125, 395

lātrīna, lātrīnae f.

noun, first declension

toilet or latrine

Other words

  • forica, foricae f. — a public toilet

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Juv. 3.38 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 125

  • lātrīnam prōluere — flush the toilet

    also used · modern · Traupman 317

    prōluō, to wash out, is mostly poetic and post-Augustan (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • Ad lātrīnam eāmus.

    Let’s go to the toilet.composed

  • ventrem exonerāre

    to relieve oneselfTraupman 370

  • lātrīnam prōluere

    to flush the toiletTraupman 395

  • Mihi eundum est in lātrīnam.

    I must go to the toilet.Traupman 395

See also potty, pee, toilet paper, toilet seat, toilet bowl.
